name: Artisansquare
description: Known for top-tier craftsmanship but reserving magic items for the nobility, this district is a nexus of artisan rivalry and innovation, crucial to the city’s economy and responsible for many products for exportation. The region is characterized by its many guilds, gathering artisans of similar trade, each guild competing against the others for influence and economic prosperity. The streets feature exceptional shops with ornate architecture while the air is filled with the scent and sound of artisans at work. Amidst the bustling commerce, sculptures, and gardens offer spaces of peace. The Vault, a major branch of the Bank of Hajal, marks Artisansquare as a central financial area of the Empire. Guilds frequently hire adventurers to counter or probe rival plots, as authorities are often part of the problem.
